description: A self-guided B2B messaging workshop that produces your Product Marketing Source of Truth.

defaultPrompt: Resume my messaging workshop from a checkpoint.
interface.longDescription: Build the messaging foundation your whole company can reuse. The B2B Messaging Workshop guides you through company context, customer problems, competitive alternatives, personas, value, positioning, and proof—one focused question at a time. It keeps facts separate from hypotheses, preserves sourced customer language, lets you pause and resume, and pressure-tests the finished framework before producing a clean Product Marketing Source of Truth.

name: messaging-workshop-b2b
